audience: pharmacists, regulatory and quality teams and researchers who look up FDA drug, device and food data

useCases.title: Review a drug's prescribing information
useCases.text: The AI searches drug labels (SPL) and reads the indications, warnings, dosage, adverse reactions and drug interactions for a drug.

useCases.title: Find the most reported side effects of a drug
useCases.text: The AI counts adverse-event reports (FAERS) by reaction term for a drug and shows the top terms. It can open single case reports.

useCases.title: Look up drug recalls and shortages
useCases.text: The AI searches drug recalls (class, reason, recalling firm, status) and drug shortages (status, reason, availability).

useCases.title: Find food recalls and food adverse events
useCases.text: The AI searches food recalls by class and reason, and the complaints for foods, supplements and cosmetics (CAERS).

useCases.title: Check device clearance, class, recalls and events
useCases.text: The AI searches 510(k) clearances, device classification, device recalls and MAUDE adverse events for a device or product code.

useCases.title: Look up approved drug products and drug codes
useCases.text: The AI searches Drugs@FDA for approved products, applications and sponsors, and the NDC directory for codes, dosage forms and labelers.
